integrity_checks_enabled.title: Backup Integrity Checks Enabled
integrity_checks_enabled.description: Whether scheduled integrity verification checks are actively configured and running for backup copies

checksum_validation_enabled.title: Checksum Validation Enabled
checksum_validation_enabled.description: Whether cryptographic checksums (e.g., MD5, SHA-256) are generated at backup creation and verified during integrity checks

integrity_check_frequency_days.title: Integrity Check Frequency (Days)
integrity_check_frequency_days.description: How frequently backup integrity checks are scheduled, expressed in days between checks. A value of 0 indicates no scheduled checks.

restore_test_performed.title: Restore Test Status
restore_test_performed.description: Whether periodic restore tests are conducted periodically to validate recoverability

rto_rpo_objectives_documented.title: RTO/RPO Objectives Documented
rto_rpo_objectives_documented.description: Whether Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) thresholds are formally documented in data recovery or business continuity policies

recovery_procedures_tested_within_months.title: Months Since Last Recovery Test
recovery_procedures_tested_within_months.description: Number of months elapsed since the most recent documented and validated recovery procedure test (restore drill or tabletop exercise with measured results)

last_test_met_rto_rpo.title: Last Recovery Test Met RTO/RPO Targets
last_test_met_rto_rpo.description: Whether the most recent recovery test demonstrated that restoration completed within defined RTO and data loss was within defined RPO thresholds

recovery_runbook_exists.title: Recovery Runbook Exists
recovery_runbook_exists.description: Whether a formal, documented step-by-step recovery runbook exists for data restoration procedures

runbook_completeness_level.title: Runbook Completeness Level
runbook_completeness_level.description: The degree to which the recovery runbook covers all required procedural elements: roles, steps, verification, escalation, and rollback

runbook_last_reviewed_days_ago.title: Days Since Runbook Last Review
runbook_last_reviewed_days_ago.description: Number of days since the recovery runbook was last reviewed and validated against current infrastructure and processes

runbook_tested_in_drill.title: Runbook Validated via Recovery Drill
runbook_tested_in_drill.description: Whether the recovery runbook has been validated through at least one executed recovery drill or tabletop exercise within the past 12 months

recovery_drill_conducted.title: Recovery Drill Conducted
recovery_drill_conducted.description: Indicates whether at least one full recovery drill or tabletop exercise has been conducted within the required review period

months_since_last_drill.title: Months Since Last Recovery Drill
months_since_last_drill.description: Number of months elapsed since the most recent documented recovery drill or tabletop exercise was completed

drill_outcome_documented.title: Drill Outcome Documented
drill_outcome_documented.description: Indicates whether the results, gaps identified, and remediation actions from the most recent drill are formally documented and stored

backup_retention_tiers_configured.title: Backup Retention Tiers Configured
backup_retention_tiers_configured.description: Indicates how many distinct retention windows (short, medium, long) are actively configured in the backup policy

minimum_backup_generations_per_tier.title: Minimum Backup Generations Per Tier
minimum_backup_generations_per_tier.description: The minimum number of versioned backup generations retained within any single retention tier across all configured tiers

backup_policy_documented.title: Backup Retention Policy Documented
backup_policy_documented.description: Whether the multi-tier backup retention policy is formally documented with defined retention periods for each tier

offsite_backup_configured.title: Offsite Backup Configured
offsite_backup_configured.description: Whether backup copies are stored in a geographically separate location from the primary site

air_gapped_or_offline_backup_exists.title: Air-Gapped or Offline Backup Exists
air_gapped_or_offline_backup_exists.description: Whether at least one backup copy is stored in an air-gapped or offline medium not accessible via the production network

backup_restoration_tested.title: Backup Restoration Tested
backup_restoration_tested.description: Whether offsite or offline backups have been successfully restored as part of a documented test within the defined review period

recovery_actions_logged.title: Recovery Actions Logged
recovery_actions_logged.description: Whether all data recovery actions are recorded in an audit log, including what data was restored and from which backup

operator_identity_captured.title: Operator Identity Captured in Logs
operator_identity_captured.description: Whether the identity of the operator performing each recovery action is recorded in the audit trail

log_retention_days.title: Recovery Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days that recovery audit logs are retained, supporting compliance and forensic investigation requirements

log_integrity_protection.title: Log Integrity Protection Mechanism
log_integrity_protection.description: The mechanism used to protect recovery audit logs from tampering or unauthorized modification

recovery_workflow_automation_enabled.title: Recovery Workflow Automation Enabled
recovery_workflow_automation_enabled.description: Indicates whether automated orchestration workflows are actively configured and enabled for data recovery operations including snapshot mounting, rehydration, and service restoration

workflow_coverage_scope.title: Workflow Coverage Scope
workflow_coverage_scope.description: Indicates which recovery steps are covered by the automated workflow: snapshot mounting, data rehydration, service restoration sequencing, or full end-to-end coverage

workflow_last_validated_days.title: Days Since Workflow Last Validated
workflow_last_validated_days.description: Number of days since the automated recovery workflow was last tested or validated through a drill, tabletop exercise, or actual execution with verified successful outcome

automated_hash_verification_enabled.title: Automated Hash Verification Enabled
automated_hash_verification_enabled.description: Indicates whether automated cryptographic hash comparisons are configured to run automatically after each recovery operation to verify data integrity

application_consistency_checks_enabled.title: Application-Layer Consistency Checks Enabled
application_consistency_checks_enabled.description: Indicates whether application-layer consistency checks (e.g., database integrity tests, file system checks, record count comparisons) are performed automatically after recovery completes

post_recovery_sanity_test_coverage.title: Post-Recovery Sanity Test Coverage
post_recovery_sanity_test_coverage.description: Describes the scope of automated sanity tests executed after recovery, such as sampling, full, or none

recovery_roles_defined.title: Recovery Roles Defined
recovery_roles_defined.description: Whether formal roles (e.g., Recovery Operator, Recovery Approver) are documented and assigned for initiating and approving data recovery operations

recovery_approval_workflow_enforced.title: Recovery Approval Workflow Enforced
recovery_approval_workflow_enforced.description: Whether a documented approval workflow requiring sign-off from an authorized approver before recovery execution is technically enforced in recovery tooling or ticketing systems

recovery_access_control_type.title: Recovery Access Control Type
recovery_access_control_type.description: The mechanism used to restrict access to recovery tooling and operations
